description: This file defines the SubPanelRowCounter class, which manages counting rows in subpanels within a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM context. It includes methods for generating count queries, handling relationships, and dealing with subpanel data structures.

classes.name: SubPanelRowCounter
classes.description: A class responsible for counting the number of rows in subpanels, handling relationship queries, and integrating with the CRM's database layer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SubPanelRowCounter with a focus bean.

methods.name: getSubPanelRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a subpanel based on the definition.

methods.name: setSubPanelDefs
methods.description: Sets the subpanel definition for counting.

methods.name: doGetSubPanelRowCount
methods.description: Recursively counts subpanel rows based on the subpanel definition.

methods.name: getSingleSubPanelRowCount
methods.description: Fetches the row count for a single subpanel.

methods.name: makeSubPanelRowCountQuery
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to count subpanel rows based on the relationship or function.

methods.name: makeFunctionCountQuery
methods.description: Creates a count query based on a custom function name.

methods.name: selectQueryToCountQuery
methods.description: Converts a select SQL statement into a COUNT query.
